TASHA CERDA, Mayor  MINA SEMENZA, City Clerk

If you would like to participate in this meeting, you can participate via the following
options:
  1. VIEW THE MEETING live on SPECTRUM CHANNEL 22 or ONLINE at
  youtube.com/CityofGardena

  2. PARTICIPATE BEFORE THE MEETING by emailing the Deputy City Clerk at
  publiccomment@cityofgardena.org by 5:00p.m. on the day of the meeting and write
  "Public Comment" in the subject line.

  3. ATTEND THE MEETING IN PERSON

  PUBLIC COMMENT: The City Council will hear from the public on any item on the
  agenda or any item of interest that is not on the agenda at the following times:
  Agenda Items – At the time the City Council considers the item or during Oral
  Communications
  Non-agenda Items – During Oral Communications
  Public Hearings – At the time for Public Hearings listed on the Agenda
  If you wish to address the Council, please complete a “Speaker Request” form and
  present it to the City Clerk or Sergeant of Arms. You will be called to the podium by
  name when it is your turn to address the Council. The City Council cannot legally take
  action on any item not scheduled on the Agenda. Such items may be referred for
  administrative action or scheduled on a future Agenda. Members of the public wishing to
  address the City Council will be given three (3) minutes to speak.

  4. The City of Gardena, in complying with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA),
  requests individuals who require special accommodations to access, attend and/or
  participate in the City meeting due to disability, to please contact the City Clerk's Office
  by phone (310) 217-9565 or email cityclerk@cityofgardena.org at least 24 business
  hours prior to the scheduled general meeting to ensure assistance is provided. Assistive
  listening devices are available.

  1
 STANDARDS OF BEHAVIOR THAT PROMOTE CIVILITY AT ALL PUBLIC MEETINGS

  Treat everyone courteously;
  Listen to others respectfully;
  Exercise self-control;
  Give open-minded consideration to all viewpoints;
  Focus on the issues and avoid personalizing debate; and
  Embrace respectful disagreement and dissent as democratic rights, inherent
  components of an inclusive public process, and tools for forging sound decisions

Thank you for your attendance and cooperation

  MINUTES
  Regular Meeting Notice
  Gardena City Council
  Tuesday, February 11, 2025

  The Regular Meeting Notice and Agenda of the Gardena City Council of the City of Gardena,
  California, was called to order at 7:00 PM on Tuesday, February 11, 2025, in the Council
  Chamber at City Hall 1700 West 162nd Street, Gardena, California.

  1.  ROLL CALL

  Present: Mayor Tasha Cerda; Mayor Pro Tem Rodney G. Tanaka; Council Member Mark E.
  Henderson; Council Member Paulette C. Francis; and Council Member Wanda Love. Other
  City Officials present: City Manager Clint Osorio; City Attorney Carmen Vasquez; City Clerk
  Mina Semenza; and Deputy City Clerk Becky Romero.

  PUBLIC COMMENT ON CLOSED SESSION

  2.  CLOSED SESSION - None

  CITY ATTORNEY REPORT OUT OF CLOSED SESSION

  3.  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  Iakopo “Bam” Tovio and Tre’ Harrison, both seniors at Serra High School led the Pledge of
  Allegiance. Iakopo is a dual sport athlete playing football and rugby. He plans to major in
  Mechanical Engineering and has obtained a 3.5 GPA over the course of 4 years. He is the
  ASB Vice-President, and his favorite subject is English. Tre’ is a dual sport athlete playing
  football and track. He has committed to the University of California Berkeley. He has
  maintained a 4.0 GPA for 6 years. He is ASB President, and his favorite subject is Math.

  4.  INVOCATION

  Reverend John Iwohara of the Gardena Buddhist Church led the Invocation.

  5.  PROCLAMATIONS

  5.A  "BLACK HISTORY MONTH" February 2025 – was proclaimed by Mayor Cerda

  6.  APPOINTMENTS

  6.A  Reorganization of Council Assignments of Delegates and Alternates to
  Outside/City Committees

  Approve Council Assignments to Outside / City Committees

  City Manager Osorio presented the Staff Report.

  Mayor Cerda stated that we have four (4) different Alternate positions that we need
  to temporarily fill, because these committees are so important, and we definitely want
  to make sure that they are represented by the City of Gardena. They are being
  temporarily assigned to fill in for Council Member Love.
  1

  She then asked if any of the Council Members were interested in being appointed as
  the City Selection Committee, LAFCO, Coastal and Transportation Commission
  Alternate; Council Member Henderson volunteered.

  It was moved by Mayor Cerda, and seconded by Mayor Pro Tem Tanaka, and
  carried by the following roll to Appoint Council Member Henderson as the
  LAFCO Alternate:

  Ayes:  Mayor Cerda, Mayor Pro Tem Tanaka, and Council Members
  Henderson and Francis
  Noes: Council Member Love
  Absent: None

  Mayor Cerda asked if any of the Council Members were interested in being appointed
  as the League of California Cities Alternate; Mayor Cerda volunteered.

  It was moved by Mayor Cerda, and seconded by Council Member Henderson,
  and carried by the following roll to Appoint Mayor Cerda as the League of
  California Alternate:

  Ayes:  Mayor Cerda, Council Member Henderson, Mayor Pro Tem Tanaka,
  and Council Member Francis
  Noes: Council Member Love
  Absent: None

  Mayor Cerda asked if any of the Council Members were interested in being appointed
  as the South Bay Cities Council of Government; Council Member Henderson
  volunteered.

  It was moved by Mayor Cerda, and seconded by Mayor Pro Tem Tanaka, and
  carried by the following roll to Appoint Council Member Henderson as the
  South Bay Cities Council of Government Alternate:

  Ayes:  Mayor Cerda, Mayor Pro Tem Tanaka, and Council Member
  Henderson
  Noes: Council Members Francis and Love
  Absent: None

  Mayor Cerda asked if any of the Council Members if were interested in being
  appointed as the Southern California Association of Governments (SCAG) Alternate;
  Mayor Pro Tem Tanaka volunteered.

  It was moved by Mayor Cerda, and seconded by Council Member Henderson,
  and carried by the following roll to Appoint Mayor Pro Tem Tanaka as the
  SCAG Alternate:

  Ayes: Mayor Cerda, Council Member Henderson and Mayor Pro Tem Tanaka
  Noes: Council Members Francis and Love
  Absent: None

  2
 Docusign Envelope ID: FB0997E8-65AF-4477-BA90-7AD075D332C7

  Mayor Cerda stated again that these appointments are temporary. It’s important that
  we have an Alternate in the event we are sick or unable to be there. Unfortunately,
  because Council Member Love was temporarily removed from her council
  assignments, we need to make sure we have representation.

  7.  PRESENTATIONS

  7.A  Certificate of Recognition to the Winners of the Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Cultural
  Committee of Gardena 52nd Annual City-Wide Essay Contest – Council Member
  Francis spoke and the certificates were accepted by 1st Place Winner Bianca
  Magnifco and 3rd Place Winner Gianna Streeter; 2nd Place Winner Kayden
  Moore was not in attendance. Each of the winners spoke and appropriate
  photos were taken; Council Member Francis also mentioned that the 1st place
  winner received a scholarship award for $400, the 2nd place winner received
  a scholarship award for $300, and the 3rd place winner received a scholarship
  award for $200.

  7.B  Recognition of Members of the City of Gardena Police Explorer Post #142 for their
  Successes at the 27th Annual Chandler Tactical Competition in Chandler, Arizona
  - Chief Mike Saffell introduced all the Explorers and spoke about all their
  accomplishments at the event; the certificate was accepted by all members of
  the City of Gardena Police Explorer Post #142 and appropriate photos were
  taken; Sargent Tyler Nash spoke about all their hard work and thanked the
  Council for their continuous support and thanked Chief Saffell and all his
  advisors for all their support.

  7.C  Find and Protect Campaign Presentation – was presented by Lieutenant Alex
  Rivera
